decisions.text: Should WebhooksController be excluded from URL versioning?
decisions.resolution: Version webhooks too (/api/v1/webhooks/...) — adapters are mocked in Phase 3, no real carrier registrations to break

decisions.text: When backend versioning is deployed, must both backend and frontend deploy together, or should old routes stay alive temporarily?
decisions.resolution: Coordinated deploy — old /api/... routes removed immediately, no compatibility aliases

decisions.text: Should admin users get refresh tokens so internal tools do not force re-login every 15 minutes?
decisions.resolution: Add admin refresh tokens matching customer flow — implemented in backend US-006

userStories.title: Update React Axios client to use versioned API path
userStories.description: As a La Moda frontend developer, I want the Axios base URL changed from '/api' to '/api/v1' so that the React app calls versioned backend endpoints after the coordinated deploy with the backend team.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend/src/lib/api.ts contains baseURL: '/api/v1' replacing the previous '/api' value
No .ts or .tsx file in Frontend/src/ contains a hardcoded '/api/' path string — verified by grep returning no matches outside api.ts itself

Frontend/src/pages/customer/ReturnDetailPage.tsx line 145 href attribute reads /api/v1/customer/returns/${data.id}/label — this is a browser anchor tag for PDF label download that bypasses Axios and must be updated separately from api.ts
Frontend/vite.config.ts proxy key remains '/api' unchanged — a prefix match that already covers /api/v1/... without modification
All API call paths in page components use relative paths (e.g. '/auth/customer/login') without embedding the '/api/' segment
userStories.notes:
Must be deployed in the same release as backend US-002 and US-003 (coordinated deploy decision). Deploying this story alone will break the app because the backend will still serve the old unversioned routes until US-003 is live.

CRITICAL: ReturnDetailPage.tsx line 145 contains a hardcoded browser anchor href that bypasses Axios entirely. This is a PDF label download link and is NOT covered by the baseURL change in api.ts. It must be updated to /api/v1/customer/returns/${data.id}/label as a separate edit. The grep check will catch this if missed.

implementation.approach: Two-file change: (1) In api.ts, change baseURL from '/api' to '/api/v1' in the axios.create call. (2) In ReturnDetailPage.tsx line 145, update the hardcoded href from /api/customer/returns/${data.id}/label to /api/v1/customer/returns/${data.id}/label. The Vite proxy key '/api' covers '/api/v1/...' as a prefix match — no vite.config.ts change is needed.

verification.expect: tsc --noEmit exits 0 and grep finds no hardcoded /api/ paths in component files other than the updated /api/v1/ references

tasks: Open Frontend/src/lib/api.ts and change baseURL from '/api' to '/api/v1' in the axios.create call
Open Frontend/src/pages/customer/ReturnDetailPage.tsx and update line 145: change href to use /api/v1/customer/returns/${data.id}/label instead of /api/customer/returns/${data.id}/label
Run grep -rn '/api/' Frontend/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' and confirm no results reference a non-v1 /api/ path
Open Frontend/vite.config.ts and verify the proxy key '/api' is NOT changed — leave it as-is
Run cd Frontend && npx tsc --noEmit to confirm typecheck passes
